messages.content: The Indianapolis flights are settled, including the Thursday return. I need the three hotel nights resolved now. Compare the split stay against each one-hotel option, including local transportation since the audit team has not organized anything.

I found three workable arrangements for Monday through Thursday. The host hotel can cover Monday and Tuesday at the audit rate, but not Wednesday. A split to the Airport South Inn for Wednesday is possible. The Plainfield Business Suites has one room for all three nights, and the Crossroads Lodge is also available for all three nights on a prepaid rate. I’ll verify the Wednesday inventory, cancellation rules, room amenities, and realistic ride costs before comparing totals.
Include the Monday preparation meeting at the host hotel, both audit days at the supplier site, and getting to the airport Thursday. I do not want a room-only comparison.

Understood. I’m using these movements: airport to hotel Monday, the preparation meeting Monday evening, round trips to the supplier site Tuesday and Wednesday, any required hotel transfer, and the final ride to IND Thursday. The estimates assume individual rides rather than shared transport.
What is actually available Wednesday night at the host property? Is the audit rate gone, or is the entire hotel sold out?

The host hotel is not completely sold out Wednesday. The $189 audit rate is unavailable, but a standard king remains at $312 before tax, about $368 including tax. It can be canceled until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, July 7. Keeping that room would make the host hotel $806 including tax for all three nights, so it is not one of the economical choices.
Then price the real split, not the expensive Wednesday room there.

The split is two nights at the host hotel for $438 including tax, followed by Wednesday at the Airport South Inn for $196 including tax. Room total: $634. Estimated transport is $135: free airport shuttle Monday, $58 for Tuesday’s supplier-site round trip, $31 from the host hotel to the site Wednesday, $24 from the site to the second hotel, and $22 from there to IND Thursday. Combined room and transport total: $769.
Check that the Airport South Inn room is genuinely bookable for Wednesday, and give me both cancellation deadlines.

The Airport South Inn shows a standard king available for Wednesday, July 8 at the quoted $196 tax-inclusive total. It is cancellable without charge until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, July 7. The host hotel’s two-night reservation can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Sunday, July 5; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax.
Now the Plainfield Business Suites. Account for the meeting-room shuttle charge they mentioned.

Plainfield Business Suites has the same room available Monday through Thursday for $612 including tax. Transport is estimated at $168: $18 from IND Monday, $36 round trip for the hotel’s scheduled shuttle to the host property for the preparation meeting, $48 round trip to the supplier site on each audit day, and $18 to IND Thursday. Total room plus local transport is $780. Cancellation is permitted until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Sunday, July 5, with a one-night charge afterward.
So it costs $11 more than the split, but avoids changing hotels. What about the prepaid place?

Crossroads Lodge is $462 including tax for all three nights, prepaid and nonrefundable once reserved. Estimated rides total $252: $39 from IND Monday, $62 round trip to the host hotel for the meeting, $49 round trip to the supplier site Tuesday, $49 again Wednesday, and $53 to IND Thursday. Its combined total is $714, the lowest by $55 versus the split and $66 versus Plainfield Business Suites.
How much extra time does Crossroads add on Thursday? The nonstop leaves at 6:40 p.m., and I expect to finish at the site around 2:30.

In ordinary traffic, the supplier site to Crossroads is about 35 minutes, and Crossroads to IND is another 45 to 55 minutes. Retrieving luggage before heading to the airport makes the trip roughly 80 to 90 minutes before allowing for pickup delays or traffic. The split puts your bag at Airport South Inn, about 20 to 25 minutes from the site and another 15 to 20 minutes from IND. That saves approximately 40 minutes and gives materially better protection for a 6:40 p.m. departure.
Check the room details too. I need the comparison to cover what is in the room, not just where it is.

The host hotel’s standard king lists a single-serve coffee maker and mini-fridge. Airport South Inn lists both an in-room coffee maker and mini-fridge in the Wednesday king. Plainfield Business Suites also confirms both. Crossroads lists a coffee maker, but its published room details do not confirm a refrigerator; the front desk would only say one may be requested and is not guaranteed.

The coffee maker and refrigerator or mini-fridge matter to me on hotel stays when those details are available. Keep both in the comparison, although they should not override the Thursday flight margin.

That favors the split and Plainfield options on confirmed room setup. Crossroads remains the lowest dollar total, but it combines a nonrefundable payment, an unconfirmed refrigerator, and the weakest Thursday airport margin. Between the two flexible choices, the split is $11 less and positions you closer to IND on the final day; Plainfield avoids one move but adds the paid Monday shuttle.
Before choosing, lay out all three totals in one place and identify what is fixed versus estimated.

Split stay: $634 fixed room charges plus $135 estimated rides, $769 total. Plainfield Business Suites: $612 fixed room charges plus $168 estimated rides, $780 total. Crossroads Lodge: $462 fixed prepaid room charge plus $252 estimated rides, $714 total. Hotel taxes are included in every room figure. Ride amounts are planning estimates and could vary with demand, waiting time, and traffic; no shared audit-team transportation is assumed.

Choose the split. The small inconvenience is acceptable for the confirmed room setup, lower flexible total, and better airport position. Reserve only those three nights; do not replace the Thursday flight or add a rental car.

I’ll reserve the host hotel for Monday and Tuesday and Airport South Inn for Wednesday, preserving the Thursday flight and leaving the rental-car question untouched. The expected lodging and local-transport total remains $769.
Proceed, and then state the confirmations, cancellation exposure, and anything still unresolved.

Reserved the host hotel for July 6-8 under confirmation HST-76428 at $438 including tax, and Airport South Inn for July 8-9 under confirmation ASI-90817 at $196 including tax. Total lodging is $634; estimated individual rides are $135, for a projected ground-stay total of $769. The host booking is cancellable through Sunday, July 5 at 6:00 p.m. Eastern, after which one night plus tax is charged. Airport South Inn is cancellable through Tuesday, July 7 at 6:00 p.m. Eastern, after which its full one-night charge applies. Both reserved room types confirm a coffee maker and mini-fridge. Local rides are not booked, their prices remain estimates, and no shared audit transportation or rental car has been arranged. The Thursday flight remains unchanged.
